text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Half-hours per bin on a log scale (bins are 1 MW wide; Bicker Fen's are 5 MW), all history, from cleaned unflagged power. Each panel has its own horizontal axis. Bicker Fen's thermal limit is a Technical Limit and its sign is unconfirmed. The published thermal limit is a ceiling NGED does not operate to. Limits are NGED's, Supported by NGED Open Data.'
text.tspan: Half-hours per bin on a log scale (bins are 1 MW wide; Bicker Fen's are 5 MW), all history, from
cleaned unflagged power. Each panel has its own horizontal axis. Bicker Fen's thermal limit is a
Technical Limit and its sign is unconfirmed. The published thermal limit is a ceiling NGED does not
operate to. Limits are NGED's, Supported by NGED Open Data.
